text:
Priya: tiny update! hit five years at Redwood today and also just accepted a promo to Senior PM 🎉 thinking a micro celebration in the cafe at 3pm — coffee + mini eclairs? who can swing by?
Marco: huge congrats priya!! 5yrs is epic. 3pm works for me. i’ll bring balloons (low-key).
Talia: omg congrats!! mini eclairs yes please. can we also sign a card? i can drop a physical card at the reception.
Priya: card would be lovely — ty! if folks want to chip in for a small desk plant/gift let me know, otherwise no pressure.
Zoe: sending so many congrats!! quick q: would you prefer no group speech? i can keep it short :)
Priya: short cheers is perfect. nothing dramatic.
Evan: congrats Priya — huge milestone. I’ll be remote but can join on video for a minute at 3:05 if that’s ok.
Sam: i made a tiny Google sign-up for treats + card runners: https://forms.gle/join-priya (really short). i’ll handle collecting $$ for the plant if people want.
pyro-bot: Event invitation proposed: "Priya: 5yr + promo mini celebration" Today 3:00 PM — Office Cafe. React with :thumbsup: to join.
Lina: :thumbsup: count me in. also adding a little confetti garland.
Marco: bringing coffee and french press. is dairy-free okay?
Priya: dairy-free totally fine. honestly just excited to see y'all. thanks for the love ❤️
Talia: adding a tiny photo frame for your desk as a keepsake. congrats again!!
Evan: posting a quick congrats video now, clip incoming.
Sam: pyro-bot created event: "Priya: 5yr + promo mini celebration" 3:00 PM — Office Cafe. Invites sent to team@redwood.com
Zoe: see you at 3! :confetti_ball:
_meta: watercooler thread: anniversary + internal promo celebration, RSVP form + bot invite, short messages and logistics
